name: Node ESM Import Extension Compliance
greenMarker: Node ESM Import Extension Compliance 100% Verified
note: Vite resolves extensionless imports; Node does not. An import that works in the browser build and throws in every gate is the exact failure this catches.

mutations.name: an import loses its .js extension
mutations.why: The bundler forgives it, so it looks fine while running the app, and then every Node-side gate that imports that module dies with ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND.
